purpose: Test whether the raw-P2P 4.5 ms tail is the previously observed Python-GC lifecycle effect.
prior_result: Raw-P2P moved 4.5 ms completion from 0/1000 to 852/1000, but its GPU1 full-NeuralRx p99 was 9.61 ms.
intervention: Disable cyclic Python GC in both persistent controller and worker before all warmup and timed work; otherwise retain the v1 raw-P2P mechanism.
claim_boundary: This two-GPU clean isolated test is neither a production d_MAC qualification nor a WCET bound. It omits MPS, external AI, a real DU clock, and real channels.
decision_rule: Report pair-completion counts at 4.5 ms; do not promote sample statistics to a bound.
